title: Blood: The Last Vampire

guide_target.label: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE 上巻・下巻（2000年オリジナル版）

routes.title: 上巻
routes.notes: Original PlayStation 2 Volume 1 (上巻), released 2000-12-21. Common prologue that must be cleared before continuing into 下巻. XNEO Set A documents all 19 numbered 上巻 endings. The replacement gameplay-video Set B independently covers the four main handoff outcomes used by the complete guide — 闇の王編, 灯子編, 瑠璃亜編, and 究明編 — through route-specific original-PS2 recordings. Optional 上巻 endings not exercised by those recordings remain Set-A-only detours and therefore use the permitted Set-B omission placeholder rather than legacy mmitsuru text.

routes.title: 闇の王編
routes.notes: Dark King arc. Reached from 上巻's 闇の王編 handoff and continued in 下巻. XNEO Set A documents the detailed 闇の王 ending branches and uses Ending 23 for the guide's main completion path. The original-PS2 下巻 闇の王編 gameplay recording is the independent Set-B component for the main route; optional alternate endings not exercised in that recording remain Set-A-only detours.

routes.title: 究明編
routes.notes: Investigation/truth-seeking arc, not tied to a specific heroine. Reached from 上巻's 究明編 handoff and continued in 下巻. XNEO Set A documents the detailed branches, including Endings 2/3/4/11/14/26 and their BLOOD thresholds. The original-PS2 下巻 究明編 gameplay recording is the independent Set-B component for the main route; alternate endings not exercised there remain Set-A-only detours.

routes.title: 灯子編
routes.notes: Touko (灯子) arc. Reached from 上巻's 灯子編 handoff and continued in 下巻. XNEO Set A documents the route's detailed Ending 6/9/10/24 branches. The original-PS2 下巻 灯子編 gameplay recording is the independent Set-B component for the main route; alternate endings not exercised there remain Set-A-only detours. Touko does not have a VNDB character entry, so no portrait is available.

routes.title: 瑠璃亜編
routes.notes: Rulia (瑠璃亜) arc on the original PS2 下巻 and the branch leading toward the true-ending variant. XNEO Set A documents Endings 15/16/17/18/20/25/27. The original-PS2 下巻 瑠璃亜編 gameplay recording is Set B for the main Ending-25 route. XNEO's Ending 25 row skips the four optional B.S.S. results 弱いって……？／瑠璃亜……／どんな人だったの？／ママさんなら…… while still completing the final 瑠璃亜をかばう search; route_rulia preserves that sequence. Optional detours not exercised by the recording use the Set-B omission placeholder.

routes.title: 真・瑠璃亜編
routes.notes: True-ending variant of 瑠璃亜編 on the original PS2 下巻. XNEO's Ending 27 row uses the same route opening as Ending 25, then additionally performs four optional B.S.S. results — 弱いって……？／瑠璃亜……／どんな人だったの？／ママさんなら…… — before also completing the final 瑠璃亜をかばう search. The route-specific original-PS2 下巻 真・瑠璃亜編 gameplay recording is the independent Set-B component for this outcome. The guide keeps XNEO's ending number in Set A while Set B contributes only gameplay-visible Japanese route text/outcome labels.

disagreements: GUIDE TARGET: original Japanese PlayStation 2 two-volume release (上巻 SCPS-15007 / 下巻 SCPS-15008), released 2000-12-21; the 2006 PSP compilation is not the target. SET-B MIGRATION: the inaccessible mmitsuru archive is no longer an active verification set. Set A remains XNEO. Set B is now the route-specific original-PS2 Japanese gameplay-video set indexed on GAMEMAN. Because gameplay recordings show in-game text rather than walkthrough prose, jpGuide2 now records only gameplay-visible Japanese choices/B.S.S. result labels/route outcomes for covered paths; saves, editorial instructions, and optional detours not exercised by the Set-B recordings use exactly （第二ガイドに記載なし）. GameFAQs remains supplementary only. ENDING NUMBERS/TITLES: the gameplay videos are route-titled rather than an independent numbered ending table, so XNEO remains the source for ending numbers; no Set-B ending-number equivalence is inferred. TRUE ENDING: XNEO's explicit Ending 25 vs Ending 27 rows establish the completion distinction used by the guide — Ending 25 skips 弱いって……？／瑠璃亜……／どんな人だったの？／ママさんなら…… but completes 瑠璃亜をかばう, while Ending 27 includes all four and also completes 瑠璃亜をかばう. The separate 下巻 真・瑠璃亜編 gameplay recording provides independent route-result evidence without being used to invent an ending-number mapping. TOUKO: XNEO presents この土地……？ and いらないよ on different 灯子編 ending rows; this migration preserves the current route topology and leaves their exact co-occurrence/order as a point for the fresh gameplay-based accuracy review rather than inferring a new branch during authoring.
